text: 聚焦“双11”｜迪士尼门票0.1元、大平层降价逾300万：噱头还是以价换量 今年“双 11"，航旅企业通过高频次碎片化促销推出低价票以吸引客流，白酒行业告别无序价格竞争回归常态，而房地产市场则在年底冲业绩压力下出现大平层房源大幅降价的“以价换量”现象。
text_en: Focus on Singles' Day | Disney tickets at RMB 0.1, large flats cut by over RMB 3 million: gimmick or trading price for volume? This Singles' Day, travel companies rolled out low-priced tickets through high-frequency, fragmented promotions to attract traffic; the baijiu industry moved past disorderly price competition and returned to normal; and the real estate market, under year-end performance pressure, saw sharp price cuts on large flats in a 'price for volume' phenomenon.
